cast.title: The Man
cast.overview: A case of mistaken identity forces a Federal agent and a dental supply salesman to team up as they speed through the streets of Detroit to pull off a sting operation and solve the murder of the agent's former partner.

cast.title: Bolt
cast.overview: Bolt is the star of the biggest show in Hollywood. The only problem is, he thinks it's real. After he's accidentally shipped to New York City and separated from Penny, his beloved co-star and owner, Bolt must harness all his "super powers" to find a way home.

cast.title: The Aristocrats
cast.overview: One hundred superstar comedians tell the same very, VERY dirty, filthy joke--one shared privately by comics since Vaudeville.

cast.title: The Super Bob Einstein Movie
cast.overview: This documentary explores Bob Einstein’s unlikely discovery and enduring career, sharing the many evolving layers of his comedy from the people that knew him best.

cast.title: Super Rhino
cast.overview: This short begins with the star canine and his owner Penny in peril from "The Man with the Green Eye", trapped within his fortress protected by overwhelming defenses, tied up and suspended high above a bottomless pit that's surrounded by fire. So Penny's father transforms Rhino into a super hamster to save the day.

cast.title: The N.Y. Friars Club Roast of Jerry Stiller
cast.original_title: The N.Y. Friars Club Roast of Jerry Stiller
cast.overview: The annual roast of the Friars Club, a fraternal organization for comedians, is a big honor - and yet can be a major embarrassment.  The roastee being honored is Jerry Stiller, who played Arthur Spooner on the CBS sitcom King of Queens.  Attendees included two at one point named New York City mayors, Police Commissioner Howard Safir, The Golden Girls' Bea Arthur, Dr. Ruth, The Brady Bunch's Florence Henderson, and comedian Janeane Garofalo.

cast.title: The Last Laugh
cast.overview: Feature documentary about humor and the Holocaust, examining whether it is ever acceptable to use humor in connection with a tragedy of that scale, and the implications for other seemingly off-limits topics in a society that prizes free speech.

cast.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
cast.original_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
cast.overview: The Turtles and the Shredder battle once again, this time for the last cannister of the ooze that created the Turtles, which Shredder wants to create an army of new mutants. Meanwhile Splinter is coming... to a decision.

cast.title: Loving Leah
cast.overview: When Leah's husband Benjamin dies suddenly, Benjamin's brother Jake is stunned to learn he is expected to marry the childless Leah to carry on his brother's name. Jake suggests to Leah that they get married and maintain a secretly platonic relationship. The harder they try to disguise their "pretend" marriage, the more their appreciation for each other's worlds grow, and out of understanding, a real love develops.

cast.title: Comedy Central Roast of Bob Saget
cast.original_title: Comedy Central Roast of Bob Saget
cast.overview: The aggravatingly amiable star of "Full House," "America's Funniest Home Videos"

cast.title: Putzel
cast.overview: For Walter, a young man endearingly known as "Putzel," life literally doesn't go beyond his neighborhood on the Upper West Side of Manhattan. Walter's dreams of taking over his family's smoked fish emporium are disrupted by the arrival of Sally, who starts a relationship with his about-to-retire and very-married uncle. In order to secure his future, Walter attempts to thwart the budding romance and falls for Sally too - throwing everyone's lives into hilarious chaos.

cast.title: What's Your Sign?
cast.overview: Two commuters -- likable salesman Joey (Jack Gindi) and working girl Linda (Judy Kuhn) -- dream of finding the perfect love but get stuck on a merry-go-round of hellish blind dates after taking advice from their best friends (Ian Kahn and Susie Essman). Gindi also takes on the writer and director roles in this jaded view of Cupid's aim as Joey's and Linda's romantic woes really begin once they meet. Artie Lange plays Joey's roving-handed co-worker.

cast.title: Cop Out
cast.overview: Detectives Jimmy and Paul, despite nine years as partners, can still sometimes seem like polar opposites—especially when Paul's unpredictable antics get them suspended without pay. Already strapped for cash and trying to pay for his daughter's wedding, Jimmy decides to sell a rare baseball card that's worth tens of thousands. Unfortunately, when the collector's shop is robbed and the card vanishes with the crook, Paul and Jimmy end up going rogue, tracking down the card and the drug ring behind its theft, all on their own time and without any backup—except for each other.

cast.title: Band Aid
cast.overview: A couple who can't stop fighting embark on a last-ditch effort to save their marriage: turning their fights into songs and starting a band.

cast.title: The Easy Kind
cast.overview: A rollicking journey toward true self-expression for Elizabeth Cook, as she breaks through the constraints of country music to become the artist that she's meant to be.

cast.title: Gilbert
cast.overview: The life and career of one of comedy's most inimitable modern voices, Mr. Gilbert Gottfried.

cast.title: Where Have You Gone, Lou DiMaggio?
cast.original_title: Where Have You Gone, Lou DiMaggio?
cast.overview: Comedian Lou DiMaggio contemplates a comeback after a 20 year absence from the stage and seeks advice from a collection of comedy greats.

cast.title: The N.Y. Friars Club Roast of Chevy Chase
cast.original_title: The N.Y. Friars Club Roast of Chevy Chase
cast.overview: Chevy Chase bitterly takes in his roast.

cast.title: Punchline
cast.overview: Lilah Krytsick is a mother and housewife who's always believed she could be a stand-up comedian. Steven Gold is an experienced stand-up seemingly on the cusp of success. When the two meet, they form an unlikely friendship, and Steven tries to help the untried Lilah develop her stage act. Despite the objections of her family and some very wobbly beginnings, Lilah improves, and soon she finds herself competing with Steven for a coveted television spot.

cast.title: Crocodile Dundee II
cast.overview: Australian outback expert protects his New York love from gangsters who've followed her down under.

cast.title: Volcano
cast.overview: An earthquake shatters a peaceful Los Angeles morning and opens a fissure deep into the earth, causing lava to start bubbling up. As a volcano begins forming in the La Brea Tar Pits, the director of the city's emergency management service, working with a geologist, must then use every resource in the city to try and stop the volcano from consuming LA.

cast.title: The Siege
cast.overview: The secret US abduction of a suspected terrorist from his Middle East homeland leads to a wave of terrorist attacks in New York.  An FBI senior agent and his team attempt to locate and decommission the enemy cells, but must also deal with an Army General gone rogue and a female CIA agent of uncertain loyalties.

cast.title: Susie Essman: One Night Stand
cast.overview: The comedienne who co-stars in HBO's 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' performs in front of a studio audience in this show.

cast.title: The Secret Lives of Dentists
cast.overview: An introspective dentist's suspicions about his wife's infidelity stresses his mental well being and family life to the breaking point.

cast.title: LEGO Marvel Avengers: Mission Demolition
cast.overview: A young, aspiring hero and superhero fan inadvertently unleashes a powerful new villain looking to rid the world of the Avengers.

cast.title: From Darkness to Light
cast.overview: Explores Jerry Lewis' unreleased 1972 film "The Day the Clown Cried," its mysterious disappearance, and the search for footage. Includes interviews with Lewis' associates and previously unseen production content.

cast.title: Theater Camp
cast.overview: After the indomitable and beloved founder of a scrappy theater camp in upstate New York falls into a coma, the eccentric staff must band together with her clueless "crypto-bro" son to keep the thespian paradise afloat.

cast.title: On Location: Women of the Night II
cast.original_title: On Location: Women of the Night II
cast.overview: Hosted by Andrea Martin

cast.title: Tax Attack '87
cast.overview: Robert Klein learns about new rules for filing taxes in 1987.

cast.title: The Good Life
cast.overview: The Good LIfe is based on the best-selling book by Drs. Robert Waldinger and Marc Schulz, directors of the Harvard Study of Adult Development, colloquially known as the “Harvard Happiness Study.” It’s the world’s longest running scientific study of happiness, initiated in 1938. The film follows five characters - Sabih Mir, a doorman who is just confronting retirement; Chris Taylor, a young dancer with the Alvin Ailey company, who is trying to understand what it means to age when your body is your livelihood and identity; D'yan Forest, a 91 yr old comedian, the world's oldest according to the Guiness book of records; Sally Quinn - journalist, novelist, and wife of the legendary Washington Post editor, Ben Bradlee; and John and Jay, two men in their 60s who have just adopted a young boy. All of them are trying to understand what it means to get older, or as we see it, to grow up. Featuring appearances by Rita Moreno, Susie Essman, Bernie Williams and Neil de Grasse Tyson.
